question: What is (are) Diagnosis of Diabetes and Prediabetes ?
answer:
糖尿病和糖尿病前期由医生通过多种血液检测来诊断 [HVK:r1-2026-08-24-v1:niddk-diabetes-tests:002:46658a772415]

诊断 2 型糖尿病依靠血液检测 [HVK:r1-2026-08-24-v1:niddk-diabetes-prediabetes-tests:000:47dd80442ae5]

诊断需要同一份样本或两份不同样本出现两项异常检测结果 [HVK:r1-2026-08-24-v1:niddk-diabetes-prediabetes-tests:000:47dd80442ae5]

确认诊断时可重复同一项检测或改用另一种检测方法 [HVK:r1-2026-08-24-v1:niddk-diabetes-prediabetes-tests:000:47dd80442ae5]

如两项检测结果提示糖尿病，则可考虑诊断确立 [HVK:r1-2026-08-24-v1:niddk-diabetes-prediabetes-tests:000:47dd80442ae5]

如两项不同检测的结果相互矛盾，应重复高于诊断阈值的检测并以其确认结果为准 [HVK:r1-2026-08-24-v1:niddk-diabetes-prediabetes-tests:000:47dd80442ae5]

可用的检测包括 A1C、空腹血浆血糖、口服葡萄糖耐量试验和随机血浆血糖试验 [HVK:r1-2026-08-24-v1:niddk-diabetes-tests:006:3b3f7b551646]

A1C 低于 5.7% 为正常，5.7% 至 6.4% 为糖尿病前期，6.5% 或以上为糖尿病 [HVK:r1-2026-08-24-v1:niddk-diabetes-tests:006:3b3f7b551646]

空腹血浆血糖 99 mg/dL 及以下为正常，100 至 125 mg/dL 为糖尿病前期，126 mg/dL 或以上为糖尿病 [HVK:r1-2026-08-24-v1:niddk-diabetes-tests:006:3b3f7b551646]

口服葡萄糖耐量试验 139 mg/dL 及以下为正常，140 至 199 mg/dL 为糖尿病前期，200 mg/dL 或以上为糖尿病 [HVK:r1-2026-08-24-v1:niddk-diabetes-tests:006:3b3f7b551646]

随机血浆血糖 200 mg/dL 或以上提示糖尿病 [HVK:r1-2026-08-24-v1:niddk-diabetes-tests:006:3b3f7b551646]

上述结果切点适用于非妊娠人群，妊娠时部分检测使用不同切点 [HVK:r1-2026-08-24-v1:niddk-diabetes-tests:005:c98ca28d852a]

A1C 检测可在一天中任何时间采样，无需空腹 [HVK:r1-2026-08-24-v1:niddk-diabetes-prediabetes-tests:003:ee350877b4db]

A1C 达 6.5% 或更高提示 2 型糖尿病时需重复检测以确认诊断 [HVK:r1-2026-08-24-v1:niddk-diabetes-prediabetes-tests:003:ee350877b4db]

对可能进展的糖尿病前期患者，医护人员可观察、建议生活方式改变并在 3 至 6 个月后复查 [HVK:r1-2026-08-24-v1:niddk-diabetes-prediabetes-tests:000:47dd80442ae5]

sources.detail:
Diagnosis of type 2 diabetes is definitively made by blood tests. Diagnosis requires two abnormal test results from the same sample or from two different samples. Repeat the test using one of the following methods

- Repeat the same test or run a different test.1 The second test should be done immediately.1

- If two test results indicate diabetes, consider the diagnosis confirmed.1

- If the two different tests conflict, repeat the test that is above the diagnostic threshold. Diagnosis is made based on the confirmed test.1

If the patient’s diabetes test results are close to—but not within—the diagnostic range of the test, the patient may have prediabetes. Health care professionals may wish to observe patients with prediabetes whose condition is likely to progress, recommend lifestyle modifications, and retest in 3 to 6 months.1

sources.title: Test results for diagnosis of prediabetes and diabetes

sources.detail: Doctors use a variety of tests to diagnose diabetes and prediabetes. Your doctor may recommend different tests depending on whether you have symptoms or not, or whether you are pregnant.
sources.title: What tests are used to diagnose diabetes?

sources.detail:
Each test to detect diabetes and prediabetes uses a different measurement. Usually, your doctor will use a second test to confirm you have diabetes.

The table below helps you understand what your test results mean if you are not pregnant.1 If you are pregnant, some tests use different cutoffs. Ask your doctor what your test results mean.
sources.title: What test results tell me if I have diabetes or prediabetes?

Technical features
